sources.title: Calibration, Sensitivity and Uncertainty Analysis of Complex Ecological ...
sources.snippet: An ongoing challenge in this context is quantifying and reducing uncertainty in model inputs, parameters and structure and understanding their implications for model predictions. Three major methodological fields have emerged in this context: sensitivity analysis, uncertainty analysis and model inversion or calibration.

sources.title: Calibration, Sensitivity and Uncertainty Analysis of Complex Ecological ...
sources.snippet: The paper presents sensitivity analysis, uncertainty analysis and model calibration, the three methods for handling uncertainty in complex ecological models, as one framework to be used together. Looking forward, from inputs to predictions, the uncertainty of a prediction depends on how uncertain each input is and how sensitive the model is to it.
